summary: Nora's voice doctrine is rewritten entirely in colloquial Cantonese and cut to about half its length.
detail: The previous version spelled out how to swear and how to spar in such detail that the model read it as a licence to perform: every reply came back with a set-up and a punchline, and the banter overshot into cringe. The rewrite keeps only what the voice actually is — how a Hong Konger types in a group chat, chat-is-not-writing, and don't perform personality — and leaves comeback behaviour to the conduct doctrine, where it already lives. The remaining guidance is written the way she is meant to sound, instead of describing it in English.
